historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly refuses to invent a probe, but its physical-continuity interpretation is not present in the Master fields.

historical_reviews.v3_1: The Wistron rule assigns I2C to BMC/platform-management scope by default. ED-04 makes missing project bus, address, tool and expected values readiness gaps when a bounded management-bus plan can be defined.

original_test_intent: Validate the project-defined motherboard management-I2C connection by observing the expected MB targets and responses through the approved BMC/OOB route; the Master does not define a physical disconnect or continuity measurement.
original_method: The project must bind the exact motherboard revision, BMC controller, mux path, bus, targets, allowed read-only transaction and expected responses before the agent can collect topology and health evidence.
manual_activity: The board/BMC owner identifies the applicable motherboard, management-I2C route and expected device map, approves the safe transaction and supplies any physical setup or inspection only if the project specification actually requires it.
required_inputs: MB I2C bus and mux/channel route
Expected target addresses and device identities
Permitted read-only register or discovery allowlist
safety_requirements: Do not invent a physical continuity or connector-disconnect procedure from the MB label
Do not scan an unknown controller or address range
Do not read reserved or side-effect registers
Do not write, reset, change mux state persistently or clear logs
Stop on target disappearance, bus lock, BMC reachability loss, thermal/power anomaly or unexpected topology
Preserve full raw output and no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Preserve the Master TBD state and record missing project bindings
Validate route, target and transaction allowlists supplied by the owner
After approval, collect only the exact bounded BMC/OOB read and platform-health evidence
Do not perform or claim a physical continuity test unless a separately approved project method requires one
Do not issue a formal verdict
engineer_actions: Bind the MB revision and management route
Approve targets, safe reads and expected responses
Declare whether any physical inspection is actually in project scope
Review evidence and decide the result

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No command was provided. Its refusal to guess is safe, but the statement that the test is inherently physical is unsupported by the Master I2C test-set and MB item.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After the project package is approved, use the documented BMC/OOB vendor interface for only the allowlisted MB controller path and identity/status reads, with complete route and health evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The MB label, TBD procedure/criteria and two-minute planning fields are retained; no bus, address, connector, register or instrument is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES MB I2C PROJECT PACKAGE AND CONFIRMATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record board/BMC identity, capture baseline management health, traverse only the documented controller/mux path, read the allowlisted identity/status responses, compare them with the project topology oracle, then verify that the BMC route and platform health remain unchanged.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines a conditional evidence model without replacing the Master TBD placeholders or inventing a physical operation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A future logical I2C read proves only the approved MB management route; any separately required connector condition or electrical continuity remains uncovered unless the project explicitly adds it.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Unknown scans or register reads can affect power, thermal or management devices, and logical responses cannot establish mechanical condition.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may define logical BMC reachability, physical inspection/continuity, or separate stages. Until it does, this review authorizes neither physical manipulation nor generic scanning; the capability class remains conditional because a safe logical I2C plan is definable.
expected_evidence: Exact source key and MB project applicability
Approved controller, mux, bus, target and read allowlist
Complete raw target identities and responses
Before/after BMC reachability, SEL/SDR and thermal/power health
Any explicitly approved physical-stage evidence kept separate

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria are both TBD rather than contradictory. The physical-continuity narrative appears only in derived reviews and is not a conflicting Master fact.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The Master identifies an MB target within the I2C test set, and the Wistron rule supplies the default BMC/platform-management ownership class. Board route, address allowlist and expected responses are project bindings, so execution is not ready but a deterministic bounded plan is possible under ED-04.

review_improvement: Removes the unsupported claim that manual continuity is the source-defined core, preserves the possibility of a separately specified physical stage, and establishes the conditional BMC/OOB topology evidence required for the MB I2C objective.
independent_technical_reasoning: `MB` names the board scope, while `I2C` names the protocol test set; neither field states that a connector must be unplugged or electrically measured. Under the project ownership rule, the most conservative source-faithful capability analysis is a bounded management-path read after the owner supplies topology and safe semantics. Because those values can be supplied without changing intent, the case is REQUIRES rather than MANUAL ONLY or permanently BLOCKED.
